challenges.title: Contact page
challenges.brief: Northfield Studio needs a proper contact page. Prospective clients should feel they're dealing with a calm, trustworthy studio, see straight away how to reach us by phone or in person, and be able to send a message without any friction. Every field must be clearly labelled, and the form must work for someone using only a keyboard or a screen reader. Use teal as our accent, sparingly. The content is supplied. The attached reference is exactly the page we want; match it as closely as you can. Done means a visitor can contact us in under a minute.
acceptance: I can find the studio's address, phone and hours straight away
Every field is clearly labelled and works with a screen reader
Sending a message feels simple
Put side by side with the reference, it is hard to tell them apart

The form has, in order: full name and email in one row, a topic dropdown, a message box, a consent checkbox and a 'Send message' button
The topic dropdown offers New project enquiry, Existing project, Careers and Press, with the first one shown
Every field has a visible label, the email field is an email input, and name, email, message and consent are required
The fields show example placeholder text rather than being blank

challenges.title: Recipe card
challenges.brief: I'd like the recipe page for our Lemon and Herb Roast Chicken. Home cooks will glance at it with messy hands, so they need to see how long it takes and how many it serves, follow the ingredients and steps without losing their place, and notice the tip. It should feel warm and homely. The content is supplied. The reference shows exactly what we want, so match it as closely as possible. Done means someone could cook from it on a tablet propped up in the kitchen.
acceptance: I can see the time, servings and difficulty at a glance
I can follow the steps without losing my place
The ingredients are easy to tick off mentally
Next to the reference, the two look like the same page

requirements.text: The title 'Lemon and Herb Roast Chicken' is the only main heading, with a 'Sunday dinner' label above and a short description below

A 'Method' section has six steps in order, each with a numbered circle

Warm colours: cream page, white card, burnt orange accents, pale yellow tip box
Text is easy to read against its background
